content.question: Which items are on the Wikimedia Living Heritage list for Cameroon?
content.answer: Items include bikutsi, toghu, achu, Poulet DG, ndolé, the Logone pony, Abbia, the Ngondo, the Nguon, the Nyem-Nyem festival, bend-skin, makossa and Fang Ngil masks. I only saw the names.
